name: Donchian breakout
idea: A signal on the first close beyond the highest high or the lowest low of the last bars (the Donchian channel); the idea has ended when the close goes beyond the opposite side of a shorter channel.

params.label: Channel bars
params.help: How many bars before the break make the channel.

params.label: Break distance
params.help: How far beyond the channel the close must be, in average true ranges (0 means any close beyond).

params.label: The idea is wrong beyond
params.help: The level that says the breakout failed: the middle of the channel, or the latest confirmed swing on the other side. When it is not on the losing side of the close, there is no signal.

params.label: Swing size
params.help: Which swings count: 0 is the smallest, 3 the largest. Larger swings need more history.

params.label: Exit channel bars
params.help: The idea has ended when the close goes beyond the opposite side of a channel of this many bars.
